name: Action Link Field
description: Outputs an action link as a computed field on the entities it targets, so it can be placed and formatted in Manage Display.
project_description: Submodule of Action Link, requiring the Computed Field module. Provides a 'Computed field' Action Link Output plugin: when enabled on an action link that targets an entity (single 'entity' dynamic parameter), a computed field named action_link_<id> is automatically attached to the bundles of the target entity type, rendering the action link's link set. A deriver (ActionLinkDeriver) derives one computed_field plugin per such action link; the ActionLink computed field plugin attaches itself as a base or bundle field to match the scope of the controlled field. Ships an action_linkset computed field type (no UI) whose only purpose is to restrict the available formatters to Default, AJAX links, and Reload links. Cache clears are triggered on action_link insert/update/delete so the derived field appears or disappears.
